purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: Who loses money if AI demand falls depends on each deal
question: Who owns the GPUs and other AI-infrastructure assets, who owes the debt, what cash flow services it, and who absorbs loss if utilization or residual value collapses?
bluf: AI infrastructure is financed through several separate structures (GPU funds, GPU loan vehicles, cloud companies, data-center property and power plants), so who owns the chips, who owes the debt and who takes the loss has to be traced one deal at a time.
use_note: Evidence through August 10 supports named ownership, obligor, servicing-cash-flow and loss chains for disclosed structures. It does not make the announced NVIDIA platforms committed capital, prove one universal AI-factory model or generalize a single transaction's risk allocation.

Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
